name: Ali Fathieh
headline: Software engineer building calm, careful tools for people who do serious work.
about: I design and build web products end to end — from the data model up to the last hairline border. Most of my time goes into interfaces that people live in all day, where small frictions compound and taste is a feature. Previously in fintech and practice management; currently interested in local-first software, editorial layout on the web, and making things that stay fast for years.

projects.title: Ledgerline
projects.description: A double-entry bookkeeping engine with a keyboard-first review queue. Reconciles 40k transactions a month for a small accounting practice.

projects.title: Quiet RSS
projects.description: A reader that fetches once an hour and never notifies you. Local-first, offline, syncs over a single file.

projects.title: Typeset
projects.description: A tiny layout engine for print-quality PDFs from Markdown — footnotes, widows and orphans, real small caps.
